ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in the lateral and distal lobe regions against 60% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central core and lower peduncle area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white areas occupy the lateral portions of both lobes; a prominent, solid low-intensity black region forms a T-shaped central core extending from the lower center to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees; vertical notch depth is significant relative to the horizontal width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration characterized by irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary; extreme jaggedness and visible pixel-level indentations at the distal tips and medial edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct circular and semi-circular high-contrast white ring-like clusters; at least four distinct rosettes are visible in the central-right quadrant and two in the central-left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation zones; multiple overlapping parallel and intersecting lines with vertical and diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged distal tips on both lobes with irregular tissue loss; prominent circular scarring patterns across the mid-section.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast white circular 'O' shaped scar located in the right-central region of the fluke surface.
